knownBlockers: Experimental validation of the pendulum needs real measurements with provenance and conditions from the owner; engineering validation is not blocked.
R3 maturity stays 0: CI capture and replay are structural and single-host, local checkouts do not fabricate host metadata, and only R0-R2 evidence exists.
The language has no way to set a process exit status; programs that report errors on stdout exit with 0.
Whole-process timing on Windows cannot resolve the pendulum phases (an empty main costs more than the whole run); in-process timing is needed.
37 worktrees with unmerged or uncommitted work and list_phi_probe.ostrin are protected; nothing there may be deleted, reset or edited.
